{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999.0 in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
# These may indicate missing or invalid values
print("Number of -999.0 in baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum())
print("Number of -999.0 in final:", (df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum())

# Check if 'responded' is actually based on change in biomarker
# Compute change
change = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Check if responded is 1 when change is positive?
print("Responded = 1 when change > 0:", (df['responded'] == 1).sum(), "out of", len(df))
print("Proportion of responded = 1 when change > 0:", (df['responded'] == 1) & (change > 0).sum() / (df['responded'] == 1).sum())

# Check if responded = 1 when change is negative?
print("Proportion of responded = 1 when change < 0:", (df['responded'] == 1) & (change < 0).sum() / (df['responded'] == 1).sum())

# Also check if responded = 0 when change > 0
print("Proportion of responded = 0 when change > 0:", (df['responded'] == 0) & (change > 0).sum() / (df['responded'] == 0).sum())"}
